response.text: {"verdict": "not_covered", "clause_ids": ["A5.1", "A5.2"], "rationale": "The claim involves a fracture of the distal radius, which was diagnosed after the insured arrived in Rimini in a state of intoxication (alcolemia 1.4 g/l). According to clause [A5.1], the insurer does not cover costs related to pre-existing health conditions or their complications. Additionally, the injury may be considered a pre-existing condition or related to intoxication, which could fall under exclusions. Clause [A5.2] also excludes coverage for planned examinations and treatments, which may apply if the injury was not accidental but related to intoxication."}
